items.note: The three props are dropped from `SceneCanvasProps`. `canvasPassThrough` now also drops every other `<Canvas>` prop SceneCanvas sets itself, in case one arrives untyped. The changeset is `major` (`fix breaking`), because code that passes one of the three stops typechecking. I made that call myself and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: A preset's own tool and another preset's built tool with one id ignore `refines`
items.note: Strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: two unrelated presets now throw.

items.claim: Inline `toolOptions` with an array or object field rebuilds every preset's tools each render
One painter at two priorities quietly keeps the first preset's
items.note: It now throws. The existing `nodeTraits.test.ts` case that expected the first priority to win was updated in the same commit. Strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: A `layers` slot field set to `undefined` erases the default `drawOne`, `paintBounds` or `handles`
Preset `chromeRules` let the last preset win, the opposite of every other merge
items.note: A refining preset's rule now wins. Strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: two unrelated presets now throw.

items.claim: Cursor and pick HUDs ignore a declared view under the pointer
Insert preview throws on an image overlay with no `extras`
`insertPreviewExtent`  had the same unguarded `extras` read for line, polygon, star and pencil
items.note: in the same commit as the insert-preview finding.

items.claim: `isAtom` called node-kind and tool-action presets bundles
items.note: Every `FeaturePreset` key is now classed in a record, so a new role fails to compile until someone classes it. A also said `toolActions` are missing from `PresetDescription.actions`. That is not a defect: the field is documented as the preset's own registration-order actions, and with `atom` now true the bundle editor no longer breaks such a preset apart.

items.claim: Polygon or star insert preview collapsed under a flipped view and kept its regular shape under a stretched one
items.note: Every preview outline, box, line and pencil included, is now built in world and mapped by the view's affine.

items.claim: Preset components were keyed by index, so toggling a preset remounted the ones after it
items.note: Each component keeps one key for as long as it lives.

items.claim: A preset component mounted after the children published its deps over theirs
